Generates nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals (Efron and
Tibshirani, 1993:
\<[doi:10.1201/9780429246593](https://doi.org/10.1201/9780429246593)\>)
for standardized regression coefficients (beta) and other effect sizes,
including multiple correlation, semipartial correlations, improvement in
R-squared, squared partial correlations, and differences in standardized
regression coefficients, for models fitted by lm().

# Package index

## Nonparametric Bootstrap

- [`NB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/NB.md) :
  Generate the Sampling Distribution of Sample Covariances Using
  Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Standardized Regression Coefficients

- [`BetaNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/BetaNB.md)
  : Estimate Standardized Regression Coefficients and Generate the
  Corresponding Sampling Distribution Using Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Multiple Correlation

- [`RSqNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/RSqNB.md)
  : Estimate Multiple Correlation Coefficients (R-Squared and Adjusted
  R-Squared) and Generate the Corresponding Sampling Distribution Using
  Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Semipartial Correlation

- [`SCorNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/SCorNB.md)
  : Estimate Semipartial Correlation Coefficients and Generate the
  Corresponding Sampling Distribution Using Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Improvement in R-Squared

- [`DeltaRSqNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/DeltaRSqNB.md)
  : Estimate Improvement in R-Squared and Generate the Corresponding
  Sampling Distribution Using Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Squared Partial Correlation

- [`PCorNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/PCorNB.md)
  : Estimate Squared Partial Correlation Coefficients and Generate the
  Corresponding Sampling Distribution Using Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Differences of Standardized Regression Coefficients

- [`DiffBetaNB()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaNB/reference/DiffBetaNB.md)
  : Estimate Differences of Standardized Slopes and Generate the
  Corresponding Sampling Distribution Using Nonparametric Bootstrapping

## Methods

  Estimated Parameter Method for an Object of Class `betanb`

  Confidence Intervals Method for an Object of Class `betanb`
